paper: ThoxShield: Bloat-Capped Counter-REA Defense for Local-First AI Artifacts

environment.note: All figures below were measured in this environment on 2026-11-10. ThoxShield fixture figures are re-derived by exp/run_experiments.py (pack-relative; needs a thoxshield binary via THOXSHIELD_BIN). Upstream figures were measured live from the bla-agents v3.2.4 tree in the same session; commands are recorded per figure.

benchmark_aggregate_token_amplification.note: Modeled estimates from the upstream token estimator; the three published/run figures disagree, so the paper cites none of them as results and uses them only to motivate claims discipline.

model.gguf.independent_check: Python struct parser: original KV keys preserved in order, tensor count unchanged, post-metadata bytes identical, nesting-breaker array depth 35

model.safetensors.independent_check: Python json parse: header valid, tensor payload bytes identical, topology nesting depth 36

core.wasm.independent_check: Node WebAssembly.validate true before and after; hardened module compiles; exports unchanged

team_loop.blocked_case: On a tree containing a planted FLAG{...} marker and a shipped source map, the loop stopped before hardening and reported both artifacts; exit code 1; report and log still written.

claims_not_made: No claim that light shields defeat a determined human analyst; defense-in-depth only.
No claim of strip resistance: removal cost measured at <1 ms with a spec-only stripper (lab v2, STRIP-01).
No live REA run against ThoxShield output yet: process-level trips remain future work; the depth-budget result is SIMULATED (in-walk budget enforcement, lab v2 SIM-02) and labeled as such.
No modeled token or dollar amplification figures are reported as results.

virtual_test_lab_v2.note: Built after the THOX Research Team review of the incoming v1 lab (8 kill shots, all dispositioned). Items computed, no hardcoded passes; reference readers (gguf-py, safetensors library, Node) provide independence; thoxshield verify is labeled SELF-CHECK.
virtual_test_lab_v2.tool_version: thoxshield v0.1.1 (GGUF alignment fix, see defect_found)
virtual_test_lab_v2.result: 12/12 evidence items pass (STRIP-01 'pass' = the limitation was confirmed and measured)

defect_found.description: v0.1.0 harden_gguf copied the post-metadata tail verbatim; on real GGUF files the tensor data section must start at the file's alignment boundary (general.alignment, default 32), so inserted metadata shifted every reader-visible tensor. Detected by gguf-py on a production 380 MB GGUF (290 tensors): all tensor byte comparisons failed pre-fix. v0.1.1 re-pads after the tensor-info region and verify now checks tensor-info identity, data-section identity, and data-start alignment.
defect_found.post_fix: gguf-py loads hardened production GGUF; all 290 tensor byte streams identical; growth +736 B (746 B of metadata adjusted by alignment re-padding, band +/-31 B).

depth_conventions.gguf_array_depth: nested ARRAY frames on the breaker chain = 35
depth_conventions.safetensors_header_depth: recursive dict/list depth of the whole header JSON, root = 1: 38 (the topology value alone measures 36; both exceed 32; earlier documents used different roots without stating them)

virtual_test_lab_v2.safetensors_added_bytes: fixture-dependent (header is rewritten): 578 B on the v1.0 fixture, 619 B on lab fixtures; NOT a constant like GGUF/WASM
virtual_test_lab_v2.team_loop_wall_ms: ~10-50 ms across runs (v1 addendum's 10-30 ms restated)
virtual_test_lab_v2.strip_limitation: A ~60-line spec-only stripper recovers GGUF/WASM originals byte-exactly and the Safetensors payload exactly (header semantically equal) in <1 ms per artifact. Light shields are analyzer-budget tripwires + attribution canaries, NOT tamper resistance. Measured, not hidden.
virtual_test_lab_v2.strip_oracle_note: Security review addition: the origin SHA-256 doubles as a strip-verification oracle and a provenance fingerprint (matchable against public base models); the breaker's +3 margin over the published limit is visible in every artifact. Both stated in the paper's Sections 7 and 9.

thoxshield_v0_1_2.note: Systems fixes folded the same night: uniform skip-if-sealed (idempotent harden; team loop succeeds on sealed trees), verify identity case + structural Safetensors header-keys check, GGUF parser depth cap 512, audit fails loudly on unreadable files. Lab v2 re-run on v0.1.2: 12/12 (binary 486,808 B, sha256 1e32e075...).
thoxshield_v0_1_2.memory_limitation: Peak RSS approx 2x artifact size (whole-file loads); measured 1,026 MiB on a 512 MiB GGUF in the systems review. Documented in paper limitations + repo docs; streaming is future work.
thoxshield_v0_1_2.version_string_fix: Pre-release correction 2026-11-10: compiled-in VERSION const read "0.1.0"; fixed to "0.1.2" and rebuilt. Binary size unchanged (486,808 B); sealed artifacts byte-identical pre/post fix (version string is not embedded in shields; canary + origin SHA-256 only), verified on the reference fixtures. Lab v2 and pilot evidence stand. Earlier v0.1.2 binary sha256 was 1e32e075fc6703f6127ca2cb40ce41164dd86265152baa790332d3c1ddb0d5d0.

release_verify_rc.verdict: Sound, honestly scoped digest-receipt utility + deterministic receipt-review harness. SHA256SUMS verify against received files; 17/17 tests pass on re-run; NIST abc vector reproduces (match exit 0, mismatch exit 1); benchmark JSON matches its paper's medians (13,056 KiB vs 74,624 KiB, 64 MiB fixture, 5 runs).
release_verify_rc.incorporation: Adopted as the receipt format for ThoxShield release manifests: manifest digests get release-verify receipts at release time. NOT merged into the thoxshield binary (keeps zero-dependency Rust scope). Its paper stays a separate engineering report; byline/consent process applies before any publication. POSIX-only (O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK); macOS/Windows evidence pending per its own status note.
